name: @openduo/channel-ambient
//files: config/ambient.md = the kind config; `duoduo channel install` copies it into the daemon's kernel config directory only when no file of that name is there, so an upgrade never clobbers a room's edited copy. web/ = the capture page's static assets; dist/plugin.js resolves them at ../web, so the two must ship together or the page 404s on an installed host.

aladuo.//: envAllowlist carries only what is genuinely read, and only addresses and credentials — behaviour knobs go through the kind/instance config instead. The channel knows exactly two downstreams: the daemon, and the cerebellum (AMBIENT_CEREBELLUM_URL/_TOKEN, both required). Hearing, transcription, voiceprints, understanding and speech all live in the cerebellum, so no model address appears in this list and none ever should. AMBIENT_HTTP_PORT is the capture page's listen port, required with no default, because a taken port shows up as a page that cannot connect while the process looks alive. The listen host is not configurable: the surface binds loopback unconditionally. AMBIENT_HTTP_ORIGINS/HOSTS are deployment additions to the capture-page allowlists; the public hostname of a tunnel or reverse proxy in front of the page comes in through them (address-class, same exception as PORT).

//dependencies: gray-matter parses the YAML frontmatter of the kind and instance md files.
